changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE chats DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_chat_target

ALTER TABLE chats ADD CONSTRAINT ck_chat_target CHECK ( (cible = 'SECTION' AND section_id IS NOT NULL AND activite_id IS NULL AND equipe_id IS NULL) OR (cible = 'ACTIVITE' AND section_id IS NULL AND activite_id IS NOT NULL AND equipe_id IS NULL) OR (cible = 'ASSOCIATION' AND section_id IS NULL AND activite_id IS NULL AND equipe_id IS NULL) OR (cible = 'EQUIPE' AND section_id IS NULL AND activite_id IS NULL AND equipe_id IS NOT NULL) )
INSERT INTO chats (nom, cible, equipe_id) SELECT e.nom, 'EQUIPE', e.id FROM equipes e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chats c WHERE c.equipe_id = e.id)
